primary: All three frozen models, E/N/EN, threshold 0.5; no held-out fitting or model selection
diagnostic_status: Designed from Basic development observation before held-out scoring; does not replace main baseline
command_presence_rule: BENIGN if n_command_log_count > 0, otherwise CYBER; descriptive development-derived rule, no learned probability
family_policy: Exact raw event family_description strings, evaluator-only; no post-result merging

bootstrap.unit: one event; all predictions/views for sampled event move together
bootstrap.stratification: resample within scenario and truth strata, preserving their sample counts
bootstrap.interval: percentile 2.5%/97.5%; descriptive conditional interval, not independent-simulation uncertainty
bootstrap.interpretation: No multiplicity-adjusted significance claims; three scenarios are insufficient to estimate population scenario uncertainty

gates: APDU dedup audit equivalent within event windows
Exactly 84 held-out IDs; same episode features for all models/views
score_policy: Predict with already-fitted Basic-only model artifacts; never fit during held-out runner
failure_policy: Fail closed on parsing/schema/hash/coverage error. Preserve lock and error; version any changes and disclose whether held-out scores were exposed.
